findings.effect_cleanup_after_new_session: No harmful cleanup found; active timer cleanup only clears its own timeout and callbacks validate the session ID.

confirmed_direct_cause: The readout was mounted in active and exiting. The same session advanced to idle and unmounted it between the store snapshot and Playwright's effective visibility observation.
root_cause_hypothesis: A long mobile render frame allows the exiting PresentationPart to snap to its zero target because the interpolation factor is capped at 1. completeFocusExit then clears session 4 in that same frame, making exiting unobservable to the locator even though the trace-before snapshot still captured it.
hypothesis_evidence_needed: actual PresentationPart Y before and after the exiting frame

instrumentation_confirmation.conclusion: Scene cleared the authoritative focus session in the same useFrame callback that first restored the numeric position. No restored frame with the exiting readout was guaranteed to paint before App unmounted it.

notices: Development continued under a documented provisional internal-prototype decision.
